title: Vector Playground
subtitle: Move the basis. Give the whole plane a new shape.
description: A graph-paper lab for real 2×2 matrix transformations, signed area, eigen-directions, dot products, and perpendicular projection. Drag the vectors, edit every coordinate, and connect the geometry to embeddings and linear layers.
instruction: Drag either basis tip or edit the matrix. Switch to Dot & projection to compare vectors and turn their projection into a matrix.
